cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
project(cpp_consumer CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# Point CMake at the Find<Crate>.cmake generated by cargo-cmake-bridge, e.g.:
#   cargo cmake-bridge --manifest-path ../../fixtures/sample-crate/Cargo.toml \
#       --out-dir ../../fixtures/sample-crate/cmake
list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/../../fixtures/sample-crate/cmake")

find_package(SampleCrate REQUIRED)

add_executable(cpp_consumer main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(cpp_consumer PRIVATE SampleCrate::SampleCrate)
